name: Night-car list reaction
description: One fixed nighttime car take with a hair touch, gaze turn and smile beneath a persistent list overlay.
lockedGrammar: Neutral look to hair touch to side gaze to smile
Passing exterior light and subtle hair airflow

variables.defaultValue: a clearly new fictional adult with a consistent face
a burgundy jacket with a tan seatbelt

examples: My odd top 5 plus five list items

shots.anchorPromptTemplate: Create {{subject_identity}} with {{gender_presentation}} presentation seated in a dark nighttime car, wearing {{wardrobe}}, framed by a fixed low console phone with passing exterior light.
shots.motionPromptTemplate: At natural real-time speed, begin neutral, raise one hand around 1.1s, touch/tuck hair around 2.1–3.4s, turn gaze toward the driver around 3.4–4.2s, then smile through the end. Keep {{subject_identity}} stable and include subtle airflow.

deterministicLayers.template: Render this exact upper-third multiline text for the full clip: {{caption_text}}

promptExamples: Use the night-car list format with a blonde woman and my five-item workout list.

notes: Text and audio scored 10/10, but motion timing scored 5.5/10 and visual fidelity 4/10.
Keep stored for iteration; do not present as a proven high-fidelity default yet.
